sys_script_fix.description: Post-import remediation for the x_casemgmt scoped application. Completes the four pieces of wiring an Update Set commit cannot perform for itself, because each is produced by a platform business rule and the commit engine applies payloads with business rules suppressed: Defect C (physical case_task/case_party tables, their fields and all seven choice lists - DDL comes from the after-insert business rule 'Synch Dictionary and Table' on sys_db_object); Defect E (auto-number default_value javascript:global.getNextObjNumberPadded(); on x_casemgmt_case.number plus maximum_digits=7 on the counters); Defect 7 (service_id on the two sys_ws_definition records); Defect 9 (the 27 sys_security_acl_role links plus a GlideSecurityManager security-cache flush). Body is scripts/post_import_remediation.js verbatim. IMPORTANT - RUNNING THIS INSTALLED RECORD CANNOT COMPLETE C OR 9. The package declares this record sys_scope=global, but the Update Set commit engine rewrites every committed record's sys_scope to the application, so after commit this Fix Script is x_casemgmt-scoped and its GlideTableDescriptor/GlideSecurityManager calls are refused. Measured outcome of running it from the Fix Script UI: verified=false, tables_built=0, acl_links_created=0, errors=121, every error being one of those two SecurityExceptions. No packaging change fixes this because the rewrite happens at commit time. THE ROUTE THAT WORKS: paste scripts/post_import_remediation.js into System Definition > Scripts - Background with 'In scope' = Global and run it - see docs/HUMAN_DEPLOYMENT_RECREATE_GUIDE.md section 5, acceptance path (b), and docs/PDI_LIMITATIONS_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md section 9.4 for the evidence. A companion after-update Business Rule ('x_casemgmt Post-Import Bootstrap' on sys_remote_update_set) that dispatched this Fix Script on commit was built, measured firing and then failing for the same reason, and has been REMOVED from the package: besides being unable to succeed, its condition fired on the commit of ANY retrieved Update Set rather than only this application's, so activating it would have dispatched this privileged, partly destructive remediation on unrelated deployments. The disclosed manual route above replaces it. This script still deactivates a legacy copy of that rule if one is installed, identified by name AND collection AND sys_update_name with exactly one match required. Idempotent and semantically convergent: every insert is lookup-guarded, every dictionary and choice attribute is compared against the package and repaired, the exact 7-list/24-value choice set is verified, and the ACL-to-role wiring is verified as an exact 27-pair set with unexpected pairs removed. The table rebuild is fail-closed: a tri-state physical-storage probe over three independent signals, no deletion unless all three agree there is no storage, and every deletion verified and read back. Emits gs.info lines prefixed X_CASEMGMT_REMEDIATION| and a final SUMMARY| line carrying verified=true|false.
sys_script_fix.name: x_casemgmt Post-Import Remediation
